listing.summary: Hello. I am new to modding on starsector and made some new hull mods to test. I am new to Java as well so please be patient and do not add if you have a save game already.

descriptionHtml: Hello.  I am new to modding on starsector and made some new hull mods to test.  I am new to Java as well so please be patient and do not add if you have a save game already.
aiDescription: Adds several new hull mods, including Bolstered Bulkheads, Desperate Measures, and Dream Drive Field. These mods modify ship armor, drive performance, cargo space, and stealth capabilities. They currently only work with base stats and are intended for specific ship types.
